comment: Advisories that match a dependency's version but are accepted - see docs/dependencies.md. status: unreachable (the vulnerable code is never used), mitigated (closed in ws-client's own code), residual (NOT closed - documented, with the way out). An entry covers exactly its artifact, versions and ids.

accepted.reason: The engine runs AsyncHttpClient without a cookie store (`setCookieStore(null)`): no cookie is stored or replayed. Pinned on every engine by `TestServers.cookieIsolation`.

Needs AsyncHttpClient's own logins (a `Realm`: Basic, Digest, NTLM, Kerberos) or proxy credentials: the engine configures neither. A site's credentials are plain request headers, and they never go on the `CONNECT` to a proxy (pinned by `TestServers.connectRequestHead`).

Denial of service while PARSING protobuf input. Akka (which shades this protobuf-java in `akka-protobuf-v3`) parses protobuf only when it deserializes messages from another node - remoting, cluster, persistence, stream refs. The engines' actor systems are local: none of those Akka modules is a dependency (this page's lists show it), so no protobuf input is ever parsed. Akka 2.6.21 is the last Akka 2.6 release; the Pekko flavor's protobuf-java (4.33.5) is not affected.
